steps.say: A game you can only beat by writing Playwright tests.
Eight floors, each built around one Playwright skill.
Every floor starts with a short lesson...

steps.scrollTo: text=Catch a tab as it opens

steps.say: ...then a trap room that only opens for a Playwright test.
Let a Playwright test do it, and the room gives up its treasure flag.
Treasure earns XP. Spend it in the loot shop...
...on titles and torches that light up the dungeon.
Climb the leaderboard. The NPCs are waiting.
Clear the floors and earn a certificate anyone can verify.
